localChanges: Settlers now take as long as in Civ1 to irrigate, mine, build roads and railroads, and clear or plant forests, with a time for each kind of terrain. Irrigating Grassland now takes 4 turns after the one you give the order on, mining Hills 9, and a road on Grassland is still there next turn (closes #261).
A Forest planted by Settlers can now have Game (closes #260).
